correctness.rationale: For ordered m-tuples A_i in M_n(K) with cross products A_i A_j=0 only for i!=j, unit sum S invertible induces commuting idempotents E_i=A_i S^-1 with E_i E_j=0 and sum E_i=I. Hence K^n decomposes as direct sum V_i and A_i are invertible on each V_i. For each weak composition r of n, G=GL_n acts transitively on decompositions with stabilizer H=product GL_{r_i}; choice of invertible block maps contributes H, yielding exactly |GL_n(q)| points each and Zariski-local bundle class [G/H][H]=[G], smooth geometrically irreducible dimension n^2 (GL special ensures local trivialization). For m2, fixing rank of A1 yields factor-through ker / quotient rank counts with leading q-degree n² iff ranks sum n, proving unit proportion 1-O(q^-1). For m>=4 the common-kernel/image square-zero family on a t=floor(n/2) plane has dimension (m+1)t(n-t)>n², giving decay power; at even n,m3 its dimension matches n² and gives the asserted limsup cap. For n2, separate nilpotent rank-one line families and singleton nonnilpotent matrices to derive the all-m exact count. Independently enumerated all tuples for (n,q,m)=(2,2,5) and (2,3,3), obtaining totals 214 and 465 and unit totals 90 and 288 respectively with GL_n(q) per composition. These computations do not replace the general scheme/dimension argument.
